name: 58c55bb9-chronicle-network-switch
description: Официальный GUI-сценарий ошибки 58c55bb9 для «Дневника»: снимок вкладки сети A содержит условие по типу, которого в B нет. После переключений A→B→A→B (окно openNetwork, скрытый «Дневник» ещё живёт состоянием A) запрос счётчиков календаря не должен уходить в B с чужим отбором. Красный гейт — правило serverLog: до фикса в логе есть POST /networks/<B>/chronicle/query → 422; после — только 200.

steps.name: open-network-a
steps.probe: (() => { const items = [...document.querySelectorAll('.network-item')]; const item = items.find((e) => (e.textContent || '').includes('{{networkName}}')) ?? items[0]; if (item === undefined) return 'no-item'; item.click(); return 'ok'; })()

steps.name: create-network-b
steps.probe: (async () => { const n = await window.etn.networks.create('Сеть B 58c55bb9 chronicle'); window.__netB = n.id; return 'ok'; })()

steps.name: create-type-a
steps.probe: (async () => { const t = await window.etn.types.createThoughtType('{{networkId}}', { name: 'Тип 58c55bb9 chronicle' }); window.__typeA = t.id; return 'ok'; })()

steps.name: open-picker
steps.eval: (() => { const plus = document.querySelector('.tab-plus'); if (plus === null) return 'no-plus'; plus.click(); return 'ok'; })()

steps.name: open-network-b-tab
steps.probe: (() => { const item = [...document.querySelectorAll('.network-item')].find((e) => (e.textContent || '').includes('Сеть B 58c55bb9 chronicle')); if (item === undefined) return 'no-item'; item.click(); return 'ok'; })()

steps.name: back-to-tab-a
steps.probe: (() => { const tab = [...document.querySelectorAll('.tab')].find((e) => !e.classList.contains('tab-plus') && (e.textContent || '').includes('{{networkName}}')); if (tab === undefined) return 'no-tab'; tab.click(); return 'ok'; })()

steps.name: inject-a-snapshot
steps.probe: (async () => { const tabs = await window.etn.tabs.list(); const tab = tabs.find((t) => t.network_id === '{{networkId}}'); if (tab === undefined) return 'no-tab'; const state = { filter: { order: 'asc', date_mode: 'presets', targets: { type_ids: [window.__typeA] } }, month: null, savedFilterId: null }; await window.etn.tabs.updateState(tab.tab_id, { chronicle_state: JSON.stringify(state) }); const fresh = (await window.etn.tabs.list()).find((t) => t.tab_id === tab.tab_id); return typeof fresh.chronicle_state === 'string' && fresh.chronicle_state.includes(window.__typeA) ? 'ok' : 'not-persisted'; })()

steps.name: refresh-tabs-via-b
steps.probe: (() => { const tab = [...document.querySelectorAll('.tab')].find((e) => !e.classList.contains('tab-plus') && (e.textContent || '').includes('Сеть B 58c55bb9 chronicle')); if (tab === undefined) return 'no-tab'; tab.click(); return 'ok'; })()

steps.name: back-to-tab-a-fresh
steps.probe: (() => { const tab = [...document.querySelectorAll('.tab')].find((e) => !e.classList.contains('tab-plus') && (e.textContent || '').includes('{{networkName}}')); if (tab === undefined) return 'no-tab'; tab.click(); return 'ok'; })()

steps.name: open-chronicle-a
steps.eval: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('button.view-tab[title="Дневник"]'); if (b === null) return 'no-tab'; b.click(); return 'ok'; })()

steps.name: a-panel-applied
steps.probe: (async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 50; i += 1) { if (document.querySelectorAll('.chron-filter-area .ft-row').length > 0) return true; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); } return false; })()

steps.name: switch-to-b-first
steps.probe: (() => { const tab = [...document.querySelectorAll('.tab')].find((e) => !e.classList.contains('tab-plus') && (e.textContent || '').includes('Сеть B 58c55bb9 chronicle')); if (tab === undefined) return 'no-tab'; tab.click(); return 'ok'; })()

steps.name: back-to-tab-a-second
steps.probe: (() => { const tab = [...document.querySelectorAll('.tab')].find((e) => !e.classList.contains('tab-plus') && (e.textContent || '').includes('{{networkName}}')); if (tab === undefined) return 'no-tab'; tab.click(); return 'ok'; })()

steps.name: switch-to-b-final
steps.probe: (() => { const tab = [...document.querySelectorAll('.tab')].find((e) => !e.classList.contains('tab-plus') && (e.textContent || '').includes('Сеть B 58c55bb9 chronicle')); if (tab === undefined) return 'no-tab'; tab.click(); return 'ok'; })()

steps.name: open-chronicle-b
steps.eval: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('button.view-tab[title="Дневник"]'); if (b === null) return 'no-tab'; b.click(); return 'ok'; })()

steps.name: b-panel-reset
steps.probe: (async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 60; i += 1) { const rows = document.querySelectorAll('.chron-filter-area .ft-row').length; const area = document.querySelector('.chron-filter-area'); const foreign = area !== null && (area.textContent || '').includes('Тип 58c55bb9 chronicle'); const issues = document.querySelectorAll('.chron-filter-area .ft-issue').length; if (rows === 0 && !foreign && issues === 0) return true; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); } return false; })()

steps.name: b-tab-snapshot-null
steps.probe: (async () => { const tabs = await window.etn.tabs.list(); const t = tabs.find((x) => x.network_id === window.__netB); return t === undefined ? 'no-tab' : t.chronicle_state === null; })()

steps.name: settle
steps.probe: (async () => { await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 2500)); return true; })()
